court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Sessions Judge, Buldhana (case no. not mentioned)
case_name: Sau. Anita Ambadas @ Ambu Shivarkar, ... vs Ambadas @ Ambu Mallu Shivarkar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sau. Anita Ambadas @ Ambu Shivarkar, aged 38 years, household
parties.respondent_defendant: Ambadas @ Ambu Mallu Shivarkar, aged 56 years, business, and others

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage of the applicant was solemnized with non-applicant no.1 as per the custom of sate-lote in 1998. The applicant filed an application under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, which was dismissed by the trial court.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to prove that the custom of sate-lote marriage exists.
legal_principles.held: It is denied that there was any custom or usage of sate-lote, as alleged.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005 — Section 2(f)

legal_principles.principle: The court will not reject evidence solely on the basis of photographs being taken by a brother.
legal_principles.held: Learned advocate submitted that the photographs were taken by brother of the applicant, who has been examined as AW-2.

outcome.final_order: The judgment and order dated 17.08.2018 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Buldhana were upheld.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
